title: Running total
prompt: Implement `long total(int[] values)` returning the sum of all elements. An empty array sums to 0.

tests.name: ordinary sums
tests.hint: Accumulate into a long from the start.

tests.name: empty input
tests.hint: Zero iterations, zero total — the loop body never runs.

tests.name: big values
tests.hint: The sum of two ints can exceed int range — the accumulator must be long.
